item.title: Will LLMs Help or Hinder the Democratic Process?
item.description: With growing reliance on LLMs for information gathering, it is critical to examine how this technology will impact elections and other exercises in political accountability.

item.title: The Middle East at a “Hinge Moment”
item.description: The Middle East has entered a hinge moment—the old order dying, a new one yet to emerge. As the region’s own actors, fortified by newfound agency, compete to shape this unsettled interval, many trajectories, from renewed conflict to stabilization, remain possible.

item.title: New Satellite Imagery Analysis Reveals an Uptick in 2026 Construction Activity at Pickaxe Mountain
item.description: Multisource imagery analysis reveals a new phase of construction at Pickaxe Mountain, Iran's underground nuclear facility. Images indicate more construction activity in 2026 than at any point in the site's history.

item.title: Why the Administration Needs to Deliver on Spectrum
item.description: Congress set an ambitious mid-band spectrum agenda; now the White House must overcome federal resistance and deliver the wireless capacity needed to deploy AI across the physical economy.

item.title: Distillation Under TRUST: The Case for a U.S.-India Trusted AI Model Distillation and Diffusion Corridor
item.description: Washington and New Delhi share a problem: Capable Chinese open-weight AI models are winning the Global South. A U.S.-India distillation corridor under TRUST could turn that shared vulnerability into shared leverage and keep Chinese models from setting AI’s terms worldwide.

item.title: Polysilicon and the Merits of Trade Measures as Industrial Policy
item.description: Trade measures alone are unlikely to rebuild U.S. capacity without domestic incentives and a coordinated ex-China global market.

item.title: The Narco Highway: Mapping the Pacific’s Drug Trade
item.description: The global drug trade is expanding across the Pacific, turning one of the world’s largest oceans into a growing trafficking corridor.
